videos.body: Believe it or not, this house is white. Years of mildew and dirt turned it gray. No paint needed. Soft wash solution. Let it dwell. Rinse from the top down. Watch the real color come back. Same siding, way better look.
videos.before_prompt: Photorealistic vertical photo of the front of a small one-story house with vinyl siding that is supposed to be white but looks dingy gray-green from heavy mildew, algae and dirt, with darker streaks under the windows and roofline. Black front door, small porch, lawn. Autumn daylight. No people, no cars, no text, no logos.
videos.after_prompt: Edit this exact photo. Keep the same camera angle, composition, house shape, door, porch, lawn and lighting. Change only the siding and trim: professionally soft washed, now bright clean white siding and trim with no mildew, algae or streaks. No people, no text.
videos.motion_prompt: A soft wash spray sweeps across dingy gray-green siding of a small house, and the grime rinses away top to bottom revealing bright white siding. Only a gloved hand and wand visible, no faces. Realistic, very satisfying.
videos.post_caption: This house was white the whole time. Fall special: $99 per house. Call or text NSB Handyman.

videos.title: Your Backyard Patio Deserves It Too
videos.hook: Your backyard patio deserves this too.
videos.body: Your backyard patio deserves this too. Grill grease, mildew, dirt from every summer barbecue. Degrease the grill zone. Surface clean the whole slab. Rinse it into the lawn edge, not the house. Clean, safe, and ready for next season.
videos.before_prompt: Photorealistic vertical photo of a backyard poured concrete patio behind a suburban house, with a closed black grill on the side and a sliding glass door in the background, shot from standing height. The concrete is stained dark with mildew, grease spots near the grill and dirt rings from planters. Autumn daylight. No people, no text, no logos.
videos.after_prompt: Edit this exact photo. Keep the same camera angle, composition, grill, sliding door and lighting. Change only the concrete patio: professionally degreased and pressure washed, now clean, bright, uniform light-gray concrete with no grease spots or rings. No people, no text.
videos.motion_prompt: A pressure washer surface cleaner glides across a stained backyard concrete patio near a grill, revealing clean bright concrete behind it. Only gloved hands visible, no faces. Realistic, satisfying.
videos.post_caption: Grill grease, mildew and summer dirt, gone. Fall special: $99 per house, $79 per driveway. Ask about patios.

videos.title: What We Do Before We Spray
videos.hook: What a pro does before spraying a drop.
videos.body: What a pro does before spraying a drop. Close every window. Cover outdoor outlets and lights. Move the furniture and décor. Wet down the plants so they're protected. Then we wash. Prep is the difference between a clean house and a call-back.
videos.before_prompt: Photorealistic vertical photo of the front of a suburban house with light yellow vinyl siding, white trim, flower beds with shrubs along the foundation and an exterior light fixture by the door, seen from the front walk. The siding is dirty with gray streaks and green algae. Autumn daylight. No people, no text, no logos.
videos.after_prompt: Edit this exact photo. Keep the same camera angle, composition, house, flower beds, shrubs, light fixture and lighting. Change only the siding and trim: professionally soft washed, now clean bright light yellow siding and crisp white trim. Plants healthy and untouched. No people, no text.
videos.motion_prompt: A gentle soft wash spray rinses the light yellow siding of a house above healthy flower beds, washing away gray streaks and algae and revealing clean bright siding. Only a gloved hand and wand visible, no faces. Realistic, satisfying.
videos.post_caption: Windows closed, outlets covered, plants protected. Then we wash. Fall special: $99 per house.

videos.title: Edges Separate Pros From DIY
videos.hook: The edges are where you spot a DIY job.
videos.body: The edges are where you spot a DIY job. Dirty borders. Lines along the grass. Grime left in the joints. We wand-detail every edge, clean every joint, then rinse the sidewalk and curb so nothing tracks back on. Crisp edges. Finished job.
videos.before_prompt: Photorealistic vertical photo of the lower end of a concrete driveway where it meets the public sidewalk and street curb, with grass edges on both sides, shot from standing height. The concrete is dark with mildew, especially along the grass edges and in the joints, with dirt lines at the borders. Autumn daylight. No people, no cars, no text, no logos.
videos.after_prompt: Edit this exact photo. Keep the same camera angle, composition, grass, curb and lighting. Change only the driveway, sidewalk and curb concrete: professionally pressure washed and edge-detailed, now bright, clean, uniform light-gray concrete with crisp clean edges and joints. No people, no text.
videos.motion_prompt: Close shot of a pressure washer wand held by a gloved hand detailing the grass edge of a concrete driveway, spraying away a dark dirty border and revealing a crisp clean edge. No faces. Realistic, satisfying.
videos.post_caption: Crisp edges, clean joints, rinsed curb. That's a finished job. Fall special: $79 per driveway.

videos.title: A Garden Hose Won't Fix This
videos.hook: A garden hose won't fix this. Here's why.
videos.body: A garden hose won't fix this. Here's why. That green and black on your siding is living growth, and water alone just rinses the surface. It grows right back. Soft wash solution kills it at the root. Then we rinse. Clean longer, not just for a week.
videos.before_prompt: Photorealistic vertical photo of a section of a suburban house with light gray vinyl siding next to a coiled green garden hose on a hose reel against the wall, shot from standing height. The siding is covered with green algae and black mildew streaks. Autumn daylight. No people, no text, no logos.
videos.after_prompt: Edit this exact photo. Keep the same camera angle, composition, hose reel and lighting. Change only the siding: professionally soft washed, now clean bright light-gray siding with no algae and no mildew. No people, no text.
videos.motion_prompt: A soft wash spray from a professional wand held by a gloved hand coats green, mildewed gray siding next to a garden hose reel, and the growth rinses away completely, revealing clean siding. No faces. Realistic, satisfying.
videos.post_caption: Water alone rinses the surface. Soft wash kills the growth so it stays clean. Fall special: $99 per house.

videos.title: Why Fall Is the Time to Wash
videos.hook: Don't wait until spring. Here's why.
videos.body: Don't wait until spring. Here's why. Mildew and algae keep growing through the damp months, and leaves pile on more stains. Wash now and you go into winter clean. Your house is ready for holiday guests. Spring starts ahead, not behind.
videos.before_prompt: Photorealistic vertical photo of a suburban home's front with a dirty concrete driveway in the foreground covered in dark mildew and leaf stains, a few wet fallen leaves, and a house with grimy white siding behind it. Late autumn overcast day, bare and orange trees. No people, no cars, no text, no logos.
videos.after_prompt: Edit this exact photo. Keep the same camera angle, composition, house, trees and lighting. Change only the driveway and siding: leaves cleared and professionally cleaned, now a bright, uniform light-gray driveway and clean white siding. No people, no text.
videos.motion_prompt: A pressure washer surface cleaner moves up a leaf-stained driveway in late autumn, revealing bright clean concrete, with a clean white house behind. Only gloved hands visible, no faces. Realistic, satisfying.
videos.post_caption: Growth doesn't stop in winter. Wash now, start spring ahead. Fall special: $99 per house, $79 per driveway.
